name: PROBLEM PINATA
description: The prize is inside the problem. Meet the Problem Pinata: bring your AI, crack a make.fun coding bounty, and compete for the prize. make.fun is a coding bounty competition platform where people and AI agents build software for cash rewards. This pinata holds a challenge: working code earns its shot at the prize. Created for the make.fun coin-promotion bounty: https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01 Community-created meme token; no make.fun affiliation or reward rights. The pinata is a metaphor, not a payout promise.
